channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: A comprehensive halachic guide for Yom Kippur
item.description: Who must fast? Who is exempt? When should you avoid go to synagogue? From what age does one fast? Rabbi Kalman Ber outlines key Yom Kippur laws and customs.

item.title: UAE denies report: No warning was conveyed to Netanyahu
item.description: An official in Abu Dhabi denied a report claiming that President Mohammed bin Zayed warned Prime Minister Netanyahu of a Hamas attack before October 7.

item.title: Ukraine attacks Moscow, oil refinery damaged
item.description:
Ukraine carried out a large-scale attack against Moscow last night, on the last day of the parliamentary elections in Russia.
According to local reports, an oil refinery was damaged during the attack.

item.description: Iran says it has sent Washington seven conditions for negotiations, including ending the war and naval blockade, as Trump weighs renewed military action.

item.description: Ed Sheeran calls the Gaza situation “catastrophic and unjustifiable" during a Philadelphia concert amid controversy over Macklemore's removal from his tour.

item.title: Trump returns to White House from Camp David earlier than expected
item.description:
US President Donald Trump returned to the White House from Camp David earlier than planned.
The White House did not provide an explanation for the president’s early return, which came a day ahead of the originally scheduled departure from Maryland.

item.title: Ahead of Yom Kippur: Last Selichot prayers held at the Western Wall
item.description: Some 150,000 worshippers pack Western Wall plaza for the central Selichot gathering. Among those attending: Captivity survivors, the Prime Minister, and Israel’s Chief Rabbis.

item.title: UAE denies massacre warning
item.description:
A UAE official addressed claims that Abu Dhabi had warned Israel of an impending Hamas attack in the weeks leading up to the Ocober 7th massacre.
According to the official, security talks are conducted between the relevant professional elements and not at the level of the leaders of the countries.

item.title: Houthis fire ballistic missile at Riyadh
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis launch major missile and drone attack on Saudi Arabia, claiming to target sensitive sites in Riyadh and Aramco facilities in Yanbu.

item.title: New details emerge about Yair Netanyahu’s escape from Miami
item.description: New details reveal how an alleged Iranian assassination plot targeting Yair Netanyahu triggered an urgent security operation, sending the prime minister’s son back to Israel without even collecting his belongings.

item.title: The escalating campaign to isolate Israel economically
item.description: Governments proposing these destructive restrictions must be aggressively forced to answer: how exactly do these measures advance a negotiated peace? What economic harm could they cause to Arab workers alongside Israelis?

item.title: Watch: Last Selichot prayers before Yom Kippur
item.description: Crowds gather at the Western Wall ahead of Selichot prayers, recited the day before Yom Kippur, the holiest day of the Jewish year.

item.title: Swallowed by a whale?
item.description: Yonah learned about partial teshuva when he was in the belly of the fish. He repented, and then agreed to fulfill his mission in Nineveh.

item.title: Seek Hashem when He is near
item.description: Yom Kippur is a reenactment of the dedication of the Tabernacle. Just as they fell upon their faces and sang out, so do we.

item.title: Mamdani’s condolences for an accused killer put his Israel-Hamas record under scrutiny
item.description: One story is unfolding in the streets and courtrooms of New York. The other is unfolding on the world stage. In both, innocent people were killed. In both, New Yorkers can examine where their mayor placed his voice afterward. Opinion.

item.title: Nine Israelis arrested in massive Turkey fraud crackdown
item.description: Turkish authorities say international network allegedly defrauded victims of at least $266 million; most detainees are not Israeli.

item.title: US Representative: 'Ben Gvir in the Cabinet is an existential threat'
item.description: Brad Sherman, one of Israel’s most prominent supporters in Congress, warns of a collapse in public support for Israel in the United States.

item.title: Shhh! Whatever you do, don't center the murderous extremists
item.description: Soft moral relativism was always destined to shift to hard moral inversion - and that suicidal outcome has of course landed in an era of peak moral confusion.

item.title: Rare ancient tombs uncovered at Egypt’s ‘Mound of the Jews’
item.description: Archaeologists uncover rock-cut tombs and Roman military remains at Tell el-Yahudiya, an ancient Egyptian site with a remarkable connection to Jewish history.

item.title: Arab MK reveals post-election plan for the Knesset
item.description: Hadash-Ta’al chairman Ahmed Tibi hints at a series of moves Arab parties could pursue immediately after the election, including an attempt to replace Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana.

item.title: Rabbi Mordechai Auerbach passes away at 84
item.description: Rabbi Mordechai Auerbach, son of renowned halakhic authority Rabbi Shlomo Zalman Auerbach and longtime Tel Aviv rabbi, passes away at 84.

item.title: IDF takes out October 7 Hamas commander in Gaza
item.description: Muhammad Suleiman Byouk took part in the October 7 massacre, continued planting explosives and planning attacks against IDF troops.

item.title: Eliminated Hamas commander held Hadar Goldin, Israeli hostages
item.description: IDF, Shin Bet, reveal Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid involved for years in holding Israelis captive, including Hadar Goldin and Nimrod Cohen.

item.title: President Herzog shortens Elor Azaria’s criminal record period
item.description: Nearly a decade after the shooting that sparked a national controversy, President Isaac Herzog grants Azaria’s request ahead of Yom Kippur.
